photos.llama_desc: A man and a woman standing together. The man is wearing a green polo shirt and has short, dark hair. The woman has long, light brown hair and is wearing a multicolored sweater.
A woman in a car looking out the window at a building with a sign reading "No Parking" and a "No Trespassing" sign on a fence.

One girl and one woman standing on a sidewalk in front of a house with a lawn and a few potted plants. The girl is smiling and has her hands in her pockets, while the woman is standing with her arms at her sides. The house has a brick front and a white door, and there is a small garden bed with a few flowers and a small tree in the front yard.
Three girls and one adult sitting in the snow at night. They are all smiling and looking directly at the camera. The girls are wearing winter clothing, including coats, hats, and gloves.

One child and nine adults in a library or school classroom. A group of children, all wearing bunny ears, stand on a colorful rug with a large, blue, flower-patterned mat in the foreground. The children are holding paper bunny ears and some are wearing them on their heads.

A Christmas tree in a living room. The tree is decorated with colorful lights and ornaments, and a red tree skirt is placed at the base. The room is dimly lit, with the tree's lights and a few other lights in the room creating a warm and cozy atmosphere.

A girl in a red t-shirt... 
She is sitting on a blue chair, holding a white tissue to her nose, and looking up at the camera with a mix of sadness and frustration. Her hair is tied in a ponytail and her legs are stretched out in front of her. The chair is in a classroom or office setting, with a whiteboard or chalkboard in the background.

A woman in a red sweater and a young boy in a red shirt sit at a table, both smiling as they unwrap a gift. The woman is holding a white paper package, and the boy is holding a small, wrapped gift. The table is set with a red tablecloth, and there are several gifts and packages on the table.

A family of five sitting on a couch. The family is sitting together, with the father holding a young girl on his lap, while the mother sits to his right, and the two other children sit on the couch to the left of the father. The family is sitting in a living room with a couch, a coffee table, and a wall with a few stars on it.

The main subject is a small dog, likely a Yorkshire Terrier, lying on a bed with a red collar and a white tissue paper on its back. The dog is lying on a bed with a green comforter and a brown blanket, surrounded by pillows and a few toys. The dog is not moving or reacting to the tissue paper on its back.

The main subject of this photo is a young woman in a white graduation gown and cap, sitting on a stone wall. She has long blonde hair and is wearing a gold medal around her neck, with multiple colorful tassels and a white, pink, and blue tassel on her left side. The setting is a park or a green space with trees and a grassy lawn in the background.

A girl holding up a green shirt with a large silver star on it. She is standing in front of a window with a white frame, and there are several colorful gift bags and a large pink gift wrapped in a princess-themed paper behind her.

Two people and one vehicle on a highway. A person in a bright orange vest is standing on the side of a highway, holding a sign that reads "Use both lanes during backups." The sign is positioned near a highway exit, with a large truck visible in the background. The sky above is a clear blue.

A man in a baseball cap... 
He is standing in front of a large stone with a bronze sword embedded in it, with his hands on the hilt. The stone is a dark grey rock with a bronze sword stuck in it, with a bronze hilt and a gold sword blade. The man is wearing a baseball cap and a striped shirt.

A man in a suit and white shirt... 
He is standing on a stage, singing into a microphone. His arms are outstretched and his hands are open. He is surrounded by a bright, blue and red light.

One adult and 23 children on a school bus. A yellow school bus is parked on a paved road, with a few trees and a parking lot in the background. The bus is empty, with all the seats and windows empty and unoccupied.
Four children and one adult in Halloween costumes standing in front of a house decorated with a large inflatable Halloween display featuring three ghosts on top of a giant pumpkin.

A group of children on a stage with a man in a red Hawaiian shirt. The children are holding papers and looking at the man, who is sitting in a chair with his back to the camera. The stage is set with a few chairs and a table with a computer and a projector.

A man in a blue t-shirt holding a black coffee cup... He is sitting in front of a TV and a bookshelf, with a stack of pillows and a white teddy bear to his left. He is smiling and holding the cup in his right hand, with his left hand resting on the stack of pillows. The TV is a Sony model, and the bookshelf is made of dark wood with several framed photos and a small gold statue on the top shelf.

A woman with long, dark hair and a red shirt is smiling directly at the camera. She has a few freckles on her face and her eyes are looking directly at the camera. The background is out of focus, but it appears to be a room with a white wall and a few plants in the distance.

A woman in a red cardigan and a white shirt sits at a table with four children, all of whom are eating breakfast. The table is set with a variety of food, including pancakes, fruit, and milk, and the children are using a range of utensils and drinking from cups. The table is in a school cafeteria or dining room, with other tables and chairs in the background.

Nine girls in soccer uniforms standing together on a grassy field. They are all wearing identical light purple shirts with black shorts and white socks, and have their arms around each other's shoulders. The girls are smiling and looking directly at the camera.

A young girl in a black witch's hat and purple cape. She is smiling and looking directly at the camera, her eyes and face clearly visible. She is standing in a darkened room or hall, with a few people in the background, but her focus is on the camera.

A young girl in a red shirt and blue jeans... 
She is standing on a kitchen counter, holding a purple flower and wearing a pair of glasses. She is barefoot and has a few colorful bracelets on her wrists. The kitchen counter is cluttered with various kitchen items and a sink is visible in the background.

A young girl in a red plaid shawl... She is standing on a grassy lawn, looking directly at the camera with a serious expression. She is wearing a white shirt, a blue denim skirt, and black Mary Jane shoes. Behind her, a brick wall with a window and a garden with white flowers and green plants.

A boy in a red shirt... 
He is holding a soccer ball and a Puma shoe box. He is sitting on a black chair with a white table in the background.

A group of children in front of a large, grey, stone bear statue. They are standing on a stone path, with the bear's head and body behind them, and are smiling and holding small, grey, stuffed bears. The children are wearing casual, summer clothing and are standing in a park or outdoor recreational area, surrounded by trees and grass.
A night sky with a large, bright, and colorful explosion of fireworks in the distance, reflected in a body of water.

A couple in a living room... 
They are sitting in front of a Christmas tree decorated with gold and silver ornaments, surrounded by presents and a fireplace with a few holiday-themed decorations. The woman is wearing a red cardigan and the man is wearing a black sweater.

One girl and one adult at a birthday party. A girl with her eyes closed and mouth slightly open, blowing out candles on a yellow cake with pink, blue, and purple polka dots, surrounded by lit candles and a few unlit ones. The cake is on a white doily on a table with a lace tablecloth.

Two young girls in Halloween costumes stand on a sidewalk, holding hands and smiling at the camera. The girl on the left wears a pink and orange costume with a long, flowing skirt and a matching hat, while the girl on the right is dressed as a fairy, wearing a pink and yellow costume with a long, flowing skirt and a matching hat. They stand on a sidewalk, surrounded by fallen leaves and grass.

A man in a plaid shirt... 
He is standing with his arm around a woman with long blonde hair. They are both smiling and looking directly at the camera. The woman's eyes are blue and her hair is styled in a long, straight, blonde hair.
A group of prairie dogs. They are standing near a log and a hole in the ground, with one of them looking out of the hole. The surrounding area is covered in grass and dirt.
Twelve cupcakes with green frosting and candy eggs on top, arranged in a clear glass baking dish on a blue and gold tablecloth.

A person swimming in a pool. The person is swimming in the center of the pool, with their body and head submerged in the water. The pool is a dark, greenish-blue color, and the person's body is a dark, shadowy shape.

One girl and one adult in a swimming pool. A young girl in a purple swimsuit with a sparkly skirt stands on the edge of a swimming pool, holding a white card with a red cross on it. The pool is green and has a few steps leading into the water.

A woman in a red swimsuit is sliding down a green water slide into a pool. She is surrounded by water splashing and her body is visible as she is sliding down. The pool is blue and has a few people swimming in it.

Two girls and one adult standing together in a dimly lit room with a large stage behind them. The girls are both wearing dresses: one in a black and white checkered pattern with a white belt, and the other in a long, light blue skirt with a black top. The adult is standing to the left of the girls, but their face is not visible.

A group of children in red soccer jerseys... 
They are standing in a field, wearing matching red jerseys with white stripes and black shorts, with some wearing black socks and others wearing white ones. The children are smiling and looking at the camera, with some of them holding their soccer balls or standing on the field. In the background, there is a soccer goal and a field with grass and trees.

A bicycle frame with a small scratch on the top tube. The bike is black with a silver and gray design, and the word "COTIP" is written in red on the frame. The bike is outdoors, with a blurred background of a brick wall.

Two adults and one child in a home setting. A woman with curly brown hair and a man with a short beard and glasses are standing behind a large gift box, surrounded by a few framed photographs on the wall. The woman is wearing a striped shirt and the man is wearing an orange polo shirt.

One woman and three children standing in front of a covered bridge. The woman is standing in the center of the bridge, with the children standing on either side of her. The bridge is a wooden structure with a sloping roof and a sign above the entrance.

A woman in a black shirt with a name tag... 
She is hugging a young girl who is holding a painting of a smiling woman with red hair. The woman's name is written in green letters on the painting. The girl is wearing a white dress.

Two skaters and one coach on an ice rink. A group of skaters in red and white uniforms are performing a routine on the ice, with one coach standing in the center of the rink, watching. The skaters are moving in a circle around the coach, performing a choreographed dance.

Two swimmers' and one coach's equipment on a poolside table. A white swim cap with a green logo of a fish and the words "Sterling Snappers" is placed on top of a green and black swimsuit with a pattern of green lightning bolts.
Two adults and one child in a kitchen. A man is standing at a table, holding a spoon and stirring a large pot of food. A woman is sitting on a chair, holding a child's hand.

Four girls and two adults in a living room. The girls are surrounded by a mess of toys, candy, and gift wrapping paper. They are sitting on the floor, surrounded by a large, colorful, and messy area of the room.

A baby in a blue shirt... is sitting on a colorful, curved, play mat with a red, yellow, and green design, featuring a smiling, red, yellow, and blue, cartoon-like, fish-like, and other, animal-like, characters. The baby is reaching out to touch a blue, fish-like, character on the mat. The play mat is on a white, carpeted floor.

A woman in a bedroom. She is lying on a bed with a floral green comforter and a few pillows. The bed is positioned against a wall with a window, and there is a small TV on a dresser in the corner of the room.
A group of children in a classroom. They are standing in a line, holding hands, and looking at a Christmas tree in the background. The tree is decorated with colorful ornaments and a star on top.
